title: Command Palette Dock monitor configuration not refreshed properly

judgment.rationale: The report describes the same monitor reconnect and Dock rediscovery class already covered by closely related open issues. The reporter is also using 0.100.2, so current-build behavior is not yet established.
evidence: After unplugging and reconnecting a laptop dock, Command Palette does not rediscover the external monitors until Command Palette is restarted.
Issue 50486 reports Dock monitor settings not being reused after monitor reconnection.
Issue 49251 reports the Command Palette Dock not appearing after monitor changes.
Issue 49480 reports monitor detection requiring a PowerToys restart.
The reported PowerToys version is 0.100.2, older than current stable 0.101.2362.0.
judgment.recommended_action: Link this report to the related monitor-reconnect issues and ask the reporter to retest on the current stable build before opening separate implementation work.

fix_assessment.rationale: A separate fix plan would duplicate the existing monitor-reconnect investigation until current-build behavior and canonical ownership are established.

issue_context.summary: Command Palette Dock fails to return after an external-monitor dock is reconnected and appears to retain the disconnected internal-monitor topology.
known_information: The reporter uses a laptop with two external monitors through a dock and disables the internal display.
The Dock disappears when the laptop is unplugged and does not reappear when the same dock is reconnected.
Related reports 50486, 49251, and 49480 cover the same monitor-detection/reconnect area.
Automated triage requested more concrete reproduction detail and a current-build retest.
inferences: This is likely duplicate or shared ownership with the existing monitor-reconnect reports rather than an independent defect.
The old reported version could be hiding behavior already changed in current builds.
issue_context.analysis: The public facts support consolidation, not a new design. The maintainer should preserve the detailed topology and use a current-build retest to determine whether the related issue already covers the behavior.
initial_investigation: Read the complete issue body and latest automated triage comment.
Compared the described reconnect sequence with the titles and stated scope of issues 50486, 49251, and 49480.
Confirmed the report has no author reply or diagnostic archive after the triage comment.

comment.body: Thanks for the detailed monitor topology and reconnect sequence. This appears to overlap the existing Command Palette Dock monitor-reconnect reports [#50486](https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/issues/50486), [#49251](https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/issues/49251), and [#49480](https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/issues/49480). Please update PowerToys from 0.100.2 to the current stable release and repeat the same unplug/reconnect sequence. If it still reproduces, reply with the current version and whether the Dock settings show the external monitors after reconnect; that will tell us whether this report adds a distinct case to the existing investigation.

upstream_safety.detail: No comment, label, assignment, closure, or other public mutation was made.
